name: Kinga Kollár - Proposition de décision du Conseil
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the Union, of the Amending Protocol to the Agreement between the European Union and the Principality of Andorra on the automatic exchange of financial account information to improve international tax compliance
part_text:
The European Parliament approves an updated tax agreement between the European Union and Andorra. Under the deal, the two sides automatically share information about bank and financial accounts held across their borders. The update brings the agreement in line with newer international and EU rules, including coverage of electronic money products and central bank digital currencies. It also replaces outdated data protection references with the EU's current data protection law. The aim is to help catch tax evasion and money laundering.

- **What changes:** Andorra and EU countries share more account data, including electronic money products and central bank digital currencies.
- **Who it affects:** People and businesses holding financial accounts in the EU or Andorra.
- **What happens next:** The new rules apply from 1 January 2026, once the Council adopts the decision.
